name: @gaia-framework/config
description: Synchronous layered YAML/TOML configuration with environment overrides, directives and schema validation.

scripts.lint: yarn format:check && eslint --flag unstable_native_nodejs_ts_config src test/unit test/integration test/compatibility test/support test/package test/examples scripts/*.ts examples/**/*.ts && node --import=tsx test/support/check-docs.ts && node --import=tsx test/support/check-test-layout.ts
scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/build.ts --tests && c8 --all --include "dist/src/**/*.js" --exclude-after-remap=false --reporter text --reporter json --reporter html --reporter lcov cross-env NODE_ENV=test node node_modules/mocha/bin/mocha.js --timeout 10000 "dist/test/unit/**/*.test.js" "dist/test/integration/**/*.test.js" "dist/test/compatibility/**/*.test.js" --reporter json --reporter-option output=artifacts/tests.json
scripts.validate: yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn test && yarn test:coverage && yarn build && yarn test:examples && yarn test:package
scripts.benchmark:smoke: node scripts/build.ts && node scripts/benchmark.ts --smoke && node scripts/benchmark-toml.ts --smoke
